help: Grants the given amount of Exiled Sector XP to every ship in the player's fleet. Defaults to 1000 if no amount is given.
Grants the given amount of Exiled Sector XP to one ship in the player's fleet, found by its name (or part of it). Defaults to 1000 if no amount is given.
Adds copies of every hull item type to the player's cargo, each with a random roll. Defaults to 5 copies of each if no number is given, and at most 200 can be granted at once.
Adds one copy of every unique item (unique hull items and unique subroutines) to the player's cargo, each with a random roll.

Adds one wormhole anchor for every tree volume to the player's cargo, or only the anchor for the named volume (for example hegemony or exotech). Anchors whose area is turned off are still added but stay inert. Socketing an anchor does nothing yet. Dev tool for the wormhole anchors feature.
Adds Refit Schematics of every tier (Scrapped, Standard, Military and Domain) to the player's cargo. Defaults to 3 of each tier if no number is given, and at most 50 of each can be granted at once.
Adds Master Schematics to the player's cargo. Defaults to 1 if no number is given, and at most 50 can be granted at once.

Opens a Star Chart wormhole beside the player fleet, in hyperspace or a star system, leading to a generated star system with fleets, points of interest and an objective. The optional seed (a whole number), system type (SINGLE, BINARY_CLOSE, BINARY_FAR, TRINARY_2CLOSE, TRINARY_1CLOSE_1FAR or TRINARY_2FAR) and tier (1 to 15, default 1, written as a number or tier=N) can come in any order and reproduce a system; seed and type are random when left out. Adding the word breach gives the system a Spatial Breach, region=ID and layout=ID build it from atlas_regions.csv and atlas_layouts.csv, and each anomaly=ID adds that anomaly from chart_anomalies.csv (for example region=furnace layout=twin_worlds anomaly=stellar_flares anomaly=spatial_breach). side=defender, attacker or neither adds a Faction Skirmish and joins it on that side. The system has no atlas node, so clearing it records no atlas progress. Prints the seed, type, tier and objective used. Only one run can be open at a time. Dev tool for the Star Charts feature.

Shows the open Star Chart run, if any: its layout seed and type, tier, objective and objective progress, its fleet and point-of-interest counts and what its system still contains, plus counts of chart systems, chart-tagged entities, hyperspace entities, fleets, scripts, listeners, used procgen names, Economy markets and intel, to check that closed runs leave nothing behind.

Generates, opens and closes the given number of full Star Chart systems (layout, fleets and points of interest) back to back without moving the player, cycling seeds, system types and tiers 1 to 15, then reports whether the used procgen names, Hyperspace Topography scans, star systems, hyperspace entities, chart-tagged entities, fleets, scripts, listeners, Economy markets and intel are unchanged. Defaults to 10, at most 500. Runs over several frames after the console closes.

Adds random Star Charts to the player's cargo, each rolled at the given tier with its implicit and random prefixes and suffixes. Count defaults to 5 (at most 50) and tier to 1 (1 to 15). Open the Star Charts tab in the Items panel (or use ExiledSectorChartList) to move them into Star Chart storage. Dev tool for the Star Charts feature.

Adds copies (default 1, at most 100) of every loaded Atlas Catalyst to the player's cargo, or of only the one named by its item id, with or without the exiledSector_ prefix (for example breach_terminus or redeployment_orders). An unknown id lists the loaded ones. Open the atlas and its Catalysts window to use them.
Moves any Star Charts in the player's cargo into Star Chart storage, then lists every stored chart with its index, name, rarity, tier, system type, implicit and modifiers.

Opens a Star Chart wormhole beside the player fleet from the stored chart with the given index (see ExiledSectorChartList). The chart is used up, and its tier, system type, seed and modifiers shape the system. Only one run can be open at a time; a failed opening keeps the chart. Dev tool for the Star Charts feature.

Adds one Doctrine Archive for every vanilla faction to the player's cargo, or only those whose id contains the given text (for example hegemony, luddic or remnant). Each gets a random firmware revision. Dev tool for the Doctrine Archives feature.
Adds a Contraband Modspec Cache to the player's cargo with a random seed, or one that rolled the given number of nodes (for example 3). Dev tool for the modspec cache feature.

Resets one ship in the player's fleet, found by its name (or part of it), to the starting level with no XP: every node is removed, banked free allocations are cleared and item costs are refunded to cargo. Socketed items go back to storage. The Minimum Ship Level setting raises it straight back to its floor. Hull sockets are kept (see ExiledSectorRemoveHullSockets).

Locks every hull socket on one ship in the player's fleet, found by its name (or part of it), and sets its Hull Upgrade points back to the starting point. Items installed in those sockets go back to storage; the Refit Schematics used are not refunded.

Locks every unlockable skill tree area you have already unlocked (Remnant, Threat, the Abyss, Pascal, the Existential Threat, the Ancient Prototype and Enigma) again. Nodes your ships hold in them are released and their costs refunded; anchors stay socketed and their exits close. Each area reopens when its trigger happens again (fighting a Remnant or Threat fleet, destroying the Singularity, finding a Nightcross anchor, beating the whole Existential Threat fleet, discovering an Ancient Prototype wreck or entering the Frozen Heart's system); every area reopens with ExiledSectorUnlockAreas.
Lifts the lock ExiledSectorLockAreas put on the unlockable skill tree areas. Each area is open again if its normal unlock condition is met; it does not unlock areas you have not reached.

Marks the nearest unlooted salvage site with Exiled Sector drops in your location so that, on top of its normal loot, it drops three random Doctrine Archives, three random wormhole anchors (from areas in the tree when there are any), every non-unique, non-doctrine subroutine and one of every crafting material when salvaged. With spawn, first adds a research station beside the player fleet and marks that instead. Dev tool for recording loot.

Shows the Outer Reaches atlas: its seed, completed, reachable and visible system counts, atlas points, key fragments, cleared tiers and unlock flags, the nearest three of each special site (Sensor Array, Nexus, Bastion) with their x y coordinates and state, and up to 20 reachable systems with their region, faction, layout and markers. Use the coordinates with the other ExiledSectorAtlas commands.

Completes every system along the shortest lane path from your completed systems to the given system, so it becomes reachable in the atlas, without completing the system itself. The path avoids other special sites, and the systems on it grant no atlas points. Give coordinates from ExiledSectorAtlasStatus or a special site id (sensor_array, remnant_nexus, threat_nexus or bastion) for the nearest open one. Dev tool for the atlas.

Completes one atlas system as if a chart run of the given tier (1 to 15, default 1) had cleared it, whether or not it is reachable: it grants the first-clear point for that tier and the rewards of a special site (atlas points, a key fragment for a Bastion, cleansing the zone of a Nexus) and reveals around it. Give coordinates from ExiledSectorAtlasStatus or a special site id for the nearest open one. Dev tool for the atlas.

Marks one atlas system as if a chart run had closed there without its objective: it stays open but loses its markers and inserted anomalies. Give coordinates from ExiledSectorAtlasStatus or a special site id for the nearest open one. Dev tool for the atlas.

Lists an atlas system's anomalies and inserted records, or inserts an anomaly into it (as the player, or as the world with world), moves an inserted record to it, or removes one. Insertion follows the same rules as play: only insertable anomalies, never into a completed system or the one with an open run, and never beside a conflicting anomaly. Dev tool for the atlas.

Shows who holds an atlas system, hands it to another faction as a capture, or releases a capture back to its original owner. Captured systems redraw the territory borders and change their atlas traffic. Dev tool for Faction Skirmishes.
Adds atlas points (default 1) and key fragments (default 0), each 0 to 100. Dev tool for the atlas.

Wipes all atlas progress (completed, failed and cleansed systems, recorded biomes, inserted anomalies, atlas points and key fragments) and starts a new atlas with a random seed, the given seed, or the current one with same. Refused while a Star Chart run is open. Dev tool for the atlas.
